blogs.title: Why I Made This Little Corner of the Internet
blogs.excerpt: A small place on the internet that belongs to me — for ideas, experiments, things I'm learning, and thoughts worth remembering.

content.text: There is something strange about having a place on the internet that belongs entirely to you.
Not an Instagram profile. Not a WhatsApp status. Not a YouTube channel. Not a page controlled by an algorithm deciding what people should see.
Just a website.
A small piece of the internet with my name on it.
Why I made this
I made this because I wanted a place where I could put things that don't necessarily fit anywhere else.

Ideas that come to me at 2 AM. Things I'm building. Things I'm learning. Experiments that work, and the ones that completely fail. Thoughts that are too long for a social media post and too unfinished to become a polished article.
Sometimes I'll write about technology.
Sometimes about an idea I've been thinking about.
Sometimes I'll document something I'm building, simply because I want to remember how I built it.
And sometimes, maybe, I'll write about something completely random.
I don't want another content machine
I don't really want this to become another content machine.
There won't be a promise that I'll post every day. There won't be a carefully planned content calendar. There won't be a pressure to turn every thought into something valuable.
I just want to write.
A little corner of the internet
The internet used to feel a little more like that.
People made strange websites. They wrote personal blogs. They experimented. They shared things because they found them interesting.
I like that idea.
So this blog is my attempt at making one of those little corners again.
A place to leave a trail
A place to think in public.
A place to build in public.
A place to leave a trail of things I've learned along the way.
Maybe nobody reads some of these posts.
That's okay.
I'll still have written them.
And maybe, years from now, I'll come back here and find an older version of myself staring back from the screen.
That might be the best reason to write at all.
Anyway, welcome.
This is my little corner of the internet.
Let's see where it goes.
